items.headline: Taxi Men's Assn sets deadline for MIA to withdraw toll fee
items.blurb: Dakshina Kannada Taxi Men's and Maxicab Association set a 10-day deadline for Mangaluru International Airport to withdraw the Rs 50 toll on commercial vehicles entering airport premises. Honorary president and former MLA K Raghupathi Bhat warned of an indefinite relay hunger strike if the fee is not withdrawn.
items.why_channel: Airport toll deadline — Mangaluru daily-life money/commute hook.

items.headline: Govt invites public suggestions/objections on renaming DK dist as M'luru
items.blurb: The state government proposed renaming Dakshina Kannada district as Mangaluru district and invited suggestions and objections within 30 days of Gazette publication. Additional Chief Secretary (Revenue) Rajender Kumar Kataria's October 1 notification cited public demand and administrative convenience; representations can go to the CM's Secretariat, Revenue Department, or the DK Deputy Commissioner.
items.why_channel: DK→Mangaluru rename — identity + 30-day public consultation deadline.

items.headline: 22-year-old loses ₹2.37 lakh in escort service fraud
items.blurb: A 22-year-old Mangaluru resident lost ₹2.37 lakh between October 7 and 8 after responding to an Instagram ad for “Royal Escort Girls,” transferring money via QR/UPI to an Airtel Payments Bank account for deposits and fees; a complaint was filed at the Cyber, Economic and Narcotics Crime Police Station.
items.why_channel: Local fraud with ₹ figure — personal stakes for follower conversion.

items.headline: BSNL officials told to expedite works on towers
items.blurb: Udupi-Chikmagalur MP Kota Srinivasa Poojary directed BSNL officials at a progress review to upgrade facilities from 3G to 4G, maintain DG sets and batteries, and expedite new towers on 39 allotted sites. He flagged network problems at the Deputy Commissioner's office in Manipal, nearby hospitals, and tourist spots such as Kaup and Kamalashile.
items.why_channel: Udupi/DK BSNL tower push — coastal connectivity infra.

items.headline: State adds nine more taluks to drought-hit list; tally now 226
items.blurb: Deputy Chief Minister and Revenue Minister G. Parameshwara said nine more taluks were declared drought-affected (total 226), including Sakleshpur (Hassan), Khanapur (Belagavi), Hosanagara and Sagar (Shivamogga), Puttur, Moodbidri and Mulki (Dakshina Kannada), and Joida and Dandeli (Uttara Kannada); a Centre relief memorandum is due within a week.
items.why_channel: Drought tally 226 taluks — farm distress with sharp number.
